title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 093
review_goal: Differentiate toggle, tornado, and translate variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Toggle track with one large right circle fused into one short capsule on the left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the right toggle drawn as a fused shape with the knob swelling out from the track.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the capsule toggle when the switch should stay a full outline with the knob parked inside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot merges the right knob into the track instead of placing it inside a full capsule outline.

items.depicts_observation: Long capsule outline with one inner circle knob parked on the right side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the right toggle to keep the full capsule outline with the knob sitting inside it.

items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps a full capsule around the switch and places the knob inside on the right.

items.depicts_observation: Spiral funnel body with one wide top ring narrowing into one pointed lower stem
